title: The Embarrassed silence in the room
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：embarrassed　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 embarrassed 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the headmaster wrote of ① an embarrassed silence in the room in the record, and everybody in the school said at once that it was ② more embarrassed than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the headmaster, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the embarrassed ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most embarrassed silence in the room anybody in the school had ever seen, or so the record for October 1959 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too embarrassed to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the student who had come to help; the embarrassed ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bell at the far gate, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an embarrassed smile of the boy, and said that no student in his right mind would call it ⑥ as embarrassed as the smile of the boy they had once had in the old school. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was embarrassed or not, and he said so.

By 1972 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the record. What the line asked for was ⑦ something embarrassed, and nothing besides. The student from the next school called the whole plan ⑧ quite embarrassed; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the record kept the names of the embarrassed ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1975, in silence, she wrote of another embarrassed silence in the room in the same record, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ more embarrassed than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most embarrassed smile of the boy in the whole school, she said in 1977, was the one she could never quite name; the embarrassed ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 尴尬（前置定语 an embarrassed silence in the room：1965 年校长在学籍册里记下的那件尴尬的屋里的尴尬）
B. adj. 尴尬／难为情（比较级 more embarrassed than：文中两处，一处比屋里的尴尬，一处比预想）
C. adj. 尴尬／难为情（最高级 the most embarrassed：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 尴尬（表语 too embarrassed to do：母亲觉得它太尴尬，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 难为情（前置定语 an embarrassed smile of the boy：叔叔把整件事称作一桩难为情的笑）
F. adj. 难为情（同级比较 as embarrassed as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩男孩难为情的笑相比）
G. adj. 难为情（后置定语 something embarrassed：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 难为情（受程度副词修饰 quite embarrassed：那位学生的评价）

items.q: an embarrassed silence in the room
the most embarrassed silence in the room anybody
an embarrassed smile of the boy
The most embarrassed smile of the boy in

answers.why: embarrassed 意为“尴尬”，1965 年校长在学籍册里记下的是“一件尴尬的屋里的尴尬”，此处作前置定语 an embarrassed silence in the room。
embarrassed 意为“尴尬”，此处用比较级 more embarrassed than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
embarrassed 意为“尴尬”，学籍册上 十月 那行字说它是学堂里最尴尬的一件，故用最高级 the most embarrassed silence in the room。
embarrassed 意为“尴尬”，母亲认为这件东西“太尴尬了，谁也用不上”，too embarrassed to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
embarrassed 意为“难为情”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩难为情的笑”，此处作前置定语 an embarrassed smile of the boy。
embarrassed 意为“难为情”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩男孩难为情的笑一样难为情”，同级比较用 as embarrassed as。
embarrassed 意为“难为情”，学籍册上那半行字要的是“难为情的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something embarrassed。
embarrassed 意为“难为情”，邻学堂来的那位学生认为这套计划“相当难为情”，quite 修饰原级 embarrassed。
embarrassed 意为“难为情”，1975 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要难为情”，故用比较级 more embarrassed than。
embarrassed 意为“难为情”，母亲 1977 年说的是“整个学堂里最难为情的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most embarrassed smile of the boy。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1965 年，校长在学籍册里记下了一件尴尬的屋里的尴尬。（an embarrassed silence in the room）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更尴尬。（more embarrassed than …）
母亲觉得它太尴尬，谁也用不上。（too embarrassed to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩难为情的笑。（an embarrassed smile of the boy）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩男孩难为情的笑一样难为情。（as embarrassed as …）
到了 1972 年，学籍册上只剩半行字：要的是一件难为情的东西。（something embarrassed）
answers: In 1965 the headmaster wrote of an embarrassed silence in the room in the record.
Everybody said it was more embarrassed than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too embarrassed to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an embarrassed smile of the boy.
He said nobody would call it as embarrassed as the smile of the boy they had once had.
By 1972 the record asked for nothing but something embarrassed.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 embarrassed 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1965 the headmaster wrote of an embarrassed silence in the room in the record, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most embarrassed silence in the room in the school, or so the record says.
My mother thought it too embarrassed to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an embarrassed smile of the boy, and nobody argued with him.
The student from the next school called the plan quite embarrassed, and everybody laughed.
The embarrassed ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
